reserveReview.rationale: The September 15 issuer response and on-chain reads reproduce USDC $90,102.080832, frxUSD $482,631.869317 and Base treasury USDC $105,708.960000. The existing rounded composition is unchanged. Verified Ethereum custodian implementations and live getters bind both holders to canonical KRWQ and their exact collateral tokens. The Base treasury Safe has the same five signers and 3-of-5 threshold as the Ethereum custodian-owner Safe at the reviewed blocks. The adapter pins the three reviewed holders and checks live custodian token bindings; Safe control is dated research, not continuously monitored. Owner recovery functions permit withdrawal of collateral. The planned Korean Treasury Bond sleeve is not an observed holding; circulating-liability scope remains unresolved.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KRWQ live custodian asset values normalized by current USD value

custodyProfile.uncertainty: September 15 verified code and pinned reads bind the Ethereum custodians to KRWQ and canonical USDC/frxUSD. Both custodian-owner and Base treasury Safes have the same five signers and 3-of-5 threshold at review; signers are not independently identified humans and future control changes are not continuously monitored. Owner recoverERC20 allows collateral withdrawal and proxies are upgradeable. Segregation, bankruptcy treatment and rehypothecation terms remain unverified. The current treasury holds USDC, not the planned Korean Treasury Bond sleeve.
